title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) on student evaluations
counterevidence: Audited lines 523-528 in routes.py; verified that require_auth(authorization) validates JWT and explicitly verifies caller.get('role') != 'admin' and str(caller.get('uid')) != str(eval_data['alumno_id']) to raise HTTP 403 Forbidden on any mismatched student ID.

ruled_out_by.control: Mandatory ownership check verifies caller uid matches evaluation alumno_id or caller has admin role before returning record data

title: Permissive CORS wildcard Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
counterevidence: Tested with curl -i -H 'Origin: https://malicious-site.com' against the live tunnel URL /health; verified that no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is emitted for unauthorized third-party origins.

ruled_out_by.control: FastAPI CORSMiddleware parses strict allowed_origins from settings.ALLOWED_ORIGINS and refuses to reflect arbitrary Origin headers

title: Rate limiter uses request.client.host ignoring reverse proxy forwarded headers

trace.description: Incoming HTTP request to /auth/login passes through AuthRateLimitMiddleware dispatch method
Client IP extracted solely via request.client.host without inspecting X-Forwarded-For or CF-Connecting-IP
Rate limit window tracking bucket groups all reverse-proxied connections under 127.0.0.1

counterevidence: Sent 35 rapid requests through Cloudflare tunnel. While rate limiting correctly triggered at request 31 with HTTP 429, all external clients are bucketed under the same proxy loopback IP 127.0.0.1.

likelihood.reason: When hosted behind Vite proxy and Cloudflare Tunnel, all user traffic shares the loopback IP 127.0.0.1, causing legitimate users to be throttled when an attacker floods login.

impact.reason: Denial of service for legitimate users sharing the proxy bucket, and lack of rate limiting on compute-heavy video evaluation endpoints.

conditions.description: Application deployed behind reverse proxy (Vite or Cloudflare Tunnel) without header-based IP extraction.

title: Unvalidated remote image URL in multimodal search allows potential SSRF

trace.description: Authenticated user invokes POST /conocimiento/biblioteca/buscar with imagen_url payload parameter
Payload imagen_url passed into resolver_ruta_imagen_local helper
requests.get(url_clean, timeout=5) fetches remote URL without filtering loopback or RFC1918 private subnets

counterevidence: Code review of routes.py lines 1270-1275 reveals no IP blocklist (127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254, 10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.0.0/16) prior to outbound HTTP request.

likelihood.reason: Requires authenticated account with active subscription to invoke /conocimiento/biblioteca/buscar endpoint.

impact.reason: Server can be coerced into issuing internal GET requests to local services (e.g. Qdrant port 6333 or internal cloud metadata services).

conditions.description: Caller must possess valid JWT token with active subscription state.

title: Accidental public exposure of FastAPI interactive documentation (/docs, /redoc, /openapi.json)
counterevidence: Queried live Cloudflare URL at /openapi.json, /docs, and /redoc. All returned the Vite frontend SPA index.html, not backend API documentation schemas. Queried /api/openapi.json and received 404 Not Found.

ruled_out_by.control: Vite reverse proxy restricts exterior routing strictly to /api, /static, and /health; Swagger /docs and OpenAPI schemas remain inaccessible to the public tunnel

title: Permissive wildcard allowedHosts in Vite development proxy

trace.description: Vite dev server initialized with server configuration options
allowedHosts set to boolean true instead of an explicit whitelist of authorized domains
Vite accepts arbitrary Host header values, increasing exposure to DNS rebinding or Host Header injection in edge proxy environments

counterevidence: Inspected frontend/vite.config.js. Vite 5.4+ permits specifying an array of permitted domains such as ['.trycloudflare.com', 'localhost', '127.0.0.1'] rather than wildcard boolean true.

likelihood.reason: Exploitation requires attacker to manipulate DNS resolution or direct proxy connections to the local Vite process.

impact.reason: Host header injection or DNS rebinding against local development server.

conditions.description: Vite server running with allowedHosts: true in networked or tunnel-exposed environment.

title: Hardcoded default fallback secret matches production PostgREST JWT secret

trace.description: Docker compose file declares environment variable fallback for PostgREST JWT authentication
Default fallback contains explicit 64-char hex secret 1c6dce924a090f72a477a85440de79ded07a2695ef85ca3c46330b868c60281d
The exact same secret key is used in backend/.env for POSTGREST_JWT_SECRET and JWT_SECRET_KEY, enabling any repository reader to forge valid JWT tokens

counterevidence: Compared line 41 of infrastructure/docker-compose.yml with backend/.env; verified identical 256-bit hexadecimal string used for active production authentication.

likelihood.reason: infrastructure/docker-compose.yml is tracked in Git; any collaborator or public viewer of the repository has immediate access to the production JWT signing key.

impact.reason: Allows an attacker to forge JWT tokens with role: 'admin' and bypass PostgREST authentication entirely.

conditions.description: PostgREST and backend use the secret committed in infrastructure/docker-compose.yml.
